reasoning_quality_informational.v1_root_problem: Dispute tickets doubled from ~600/month (Jun–Jul) to 1180–1260 (Aug–Sep) while response times are within SLA, so the cause lies upstream in bill accuracy. Best-supported mechanism: manual reads are missed or late (route completion 0.88 vs 0.95, 9200 manual-read accounts), so billing substitutes estimates, and estimated bills drive part of the disputes (1240 of 3025). Estimates do not explain the 1785 ACTUAL-read disputes, which remain a separate open cause.
reasoning_quality_informational.v2_root_problem: Disputes doubled from about 600/month (Jun–Jul) to 1180–1260 (Aug–Sep) while responses meet SLA, so the cause is upstream in bill accuracy (E-01, E-02). Best-supported mechanism: BV-17 (deployed 2026-08-01) compares raw register values to m3 history without unit scaling, while firmware v4.2 reports 0.1 m3, so valid AMI reads are rejected as high consumption and estimated (1184 of 1240 disputed estimates).
reasoning_quality_informational.ideal_final_problem: BV-17 validation rejects valid firmware-v4.2 AMI reads (unit-scale mismatch on H-MDMS-BILL) and substitutes estimates.
